int_name: E LEHIGH AVE & N FRONT ST

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban intersection with a marked crosswalk on one leg but significant exposure for pedestrians due to the large crossing distance and lack of a median refuge. While sidewalks and traffic signals are present, the environment is dominated by wide asphalt expanses and commercial land uses like gas stations that create multiple conflict points.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide intersection requires pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median refuge, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Wide Curb Radii
hazards.description: The corners appear designed for high-speed vehicle turns, which increases the risk of right-turn-on-red or high-speed turning conflicts.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right corners of the intersection

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade the existing transverse markings to continental or ladder style for better visibility to drivers.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane urban arterial with a high-visibility continental crosswalk at a signalized intersection. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and signals are present, the long crossing distance and lack of a pedestrian refuge island increase exposure to high-speed traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four travel lanes plus parking lanes without a median or refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground, the wide continental crosswalk spanning the entire roadway.

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radii
hazards.description: The intersection geometry appears to allow for high-speed vehicle turns, increasing the risk of collisions with pedestrians in the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right corners of the intersection.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.
